claim_gate.reason: Every adaptive linear reparameterization lacks a large affine fiber component, but cancellation-based low rank and genuinely nonlinear/coherent constructions remain unclassified.

falsifiers_triggered: A label-adaptive binary linear transform cannot expose a large affine product component inside a typical low-bit fiber.

proof_obligations.statement: Bound the modular constant-function probability for every fixed affine flat by its distinct parity features.
Union-bound all affine flats selected after observing the instance, including every GL(m,2) coordinate split.
Transfer the all-flat event from an independent target to the planted witness target law.
Upgrade absence of large contained flats to approximate Schmidt-rank bounds across every balanced linear split, allowing matrix cancellation.
Classify efficiently computable nonlinear coordinate maps that might expose low-bond fiber structure.

summary: Proved that density-one low-bit fibers contain no affine flat of dimension 8log2(q) or larger with failure 2^-Omega(q log q), uniformly over every adaptive GL(m,2) reparameterization. Any support-contained cancellation-free affine cover is exponential.

theorem.affine_flat_count: At most 2^(m-r) binom(2^r-1,t)(t+1)^m/|GL(r,2)| affine flats have t selected nonzero column types.
theorem.asymptotic_union_bound: For m=2q+O(1) and r>=8log2(q), summing the fixed-flat bound is 2^-Omega(q log q).
theorem.cover_consequence: Together with full-fiber lower-tail concentration, every cover by support-contained affine flats needs 2^(q-O(log q)) pieces.
theorem.feature_independence: Distinct nonzero parity functions are rationally independent by their Walsh-character expansion.
theorem.fixed_flat_probability: For t feature types, Smith normal form and one Hadamard-bounded nonzero minor give probability at most t^(t/2)/N^(t+1).
theorem.parity_feature_normal_form: On an affine r-flat, group equal nonzero generator-column types to obtain C+sum_g B_g<g,y>_2 with independent uniform B_g.
theorem.planted_target_transfer: The planted-target likelihood ratio is N*C_s/2^m<=N, so adding q to the independent-target failure exponent preserves 2^-Omega(q log q).

theorem_contract.excluded_architecture: One large affine product component, or a polynomial-size cancellation-free cover by affine/stabilizer supports contained in the exact low-bit fiber.
theorem_contract.non_claim: No general Schmidt-rank, stabilizer-rank-with-cancellation, nonlinear tensor-network, circuit, or query lower bound.
theorem_contract.source: Independent uniform density-one modular subset-sum labels and either an independent uniform target or a planted size-biased target, with N=2^q and m=2q+O(1).
theorem_contract.transformation: Any invertible F_2-linear or affine reparameterization chosen after seeing the public labels and target.
